request.script:
[Firm, warm] Ever leave a VA appointment and remember the one thing you went in to ask? I’m Wendell, the Grill Sergeant. Let’s make a plan.

[Direct] Before a routine visit, I send my VA care team a secure message. Biggest concern first. Can’t message? Bring a note. If it’s urgent, seek care right away.

[Matter-of-fact] For example, my headaches put me in bed. I missed two shifts and my daughter’s game. Say how often, how long recovery takes, and what help you need.

At the visit, lead with what you wrote. Describe a bad day. Let your helper explain what they saw and did.

Ask, did you order the referral? Who do I call if I don’t hear back?

[Measured] When the note’s ready, read it. Did it capture your limits, help, and plan? Follow up on what’s missing.

[Deliberate] Before. During. After. Pick your next appointment. Write down your top concern.

[Warm] Message me for the free VA Claims Field Guide. Pass it on.
